entities.name: Park Tae-won
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Park Taewon, also known by his art names Mongbo and Gubo, was a Korean writer who moved from South Korea to North Korea. He is notably a grandfather of South Korean filmmaker Bong Joon-ho.
